study type: Development and pilot testing with a quasi-experimental intervention
cohort: The study included 10 pregnant women and 10 experts for the alpha test, and 60 pregnant women and 9 clinical professionals for the beta test.
finding: The developed mobile-based Patient Decision Aid (PtDA) demonstrated high usability and was effective in increasing knowledge, reducing decisional conflict, and influencing mode of delivery preferences among pregnant women.
mod_finding: The intervention group showed a statistically significant change in preference from cesarean section (CS) to vaginal delivery.
